description: Scorpio decan 2 (November 2 to November 11): personality, love, work and growth, with Neptune as sub-ruler of the second ten degrees of Scorpio.
answer: In Western astrology, the second decan of Scorpio covers 10° to 19° of the sign, roughly November 2 to November 11, with Neptune as its sub-ruler beside Pluto. It is read as intensity softened into intuition, imagination and quiet compassion. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Scorpio decan 2 personality
paragraphs: From 10 to 19 degrees, Scorpio takes Neptune, the modern ruler of Pisces, as its sub-ruler. Neptune dissolves boundaries, and when it meets a sign that guards its boundaries closely, the result is an unusual blend of protection and permeability. Natives are often described as remarkably intuitive, picking up on moods, motives and unspoken history almost before anyone has spoken. Many feel drawn to music, film, poetry or the symbolic language of dreams. Where the first decan digs for truth through investigation, this one tends to arrive at it through feeling, sensing the shape of a situation and only later finding words to explain it.

The Neptunian thread gives this decan a gentler, more mystical face than people expect from Scorpio. Compassion runs deep, particularly for anyone in pain, and they may be the friend who instinctively knows when to call. Yet porous edges bring their own difficulties. Other people's emotions can seep in, leaving them drained without knowing why. Idealisation is another theme: a person or project may be seen through a soft lens until reality intrudes. When grounded, the combination is striking. Scorpio supplies stamina and nerve, while Neptune supplies empathy and vision, so they can stay with others through hard emotional territory without flinching.

sections.heading: Scorpio decan 2 in love and at work
paragraphs: In relationships, this decan often seeks a bond that feels almost spiritual, a meeting of inner worlds rather than a practical arrangement. They tend to be devoted, tender and deeply attuned to a partner's unspoken feelings. Romance can carry a cinematic quality, full of meaningful coincidences and private symbols. The vulnerability lies in seeing what they hope to see. They may overlook warning signs or sacrifice too much in the name of love. Keeping a few trusted friends close, and checking feelings against actions over time, helps them enjoy the depth of connection without losing their footing.

Professionally, Neptune's decan of Scorpio often gravitates towards creative, therapeutic or quietly investigative work: counselling, social care, the arts, photography, music, writing, chaplaincy or roles that require reading people well. Settings where intuition is respected rather than dismissed tend to bring out their best. Sensing what a client or audience needs is often second nature. Highly competitive, purely numerical environments can wear them down, especially when the human element is missing. Time alone to recharge, and clear structures that protect their energy, help keep their sensitivity an asset rather than a slow leak.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Scorpio decan 2: what Neptune adds
paragraphs: The second decan covers 10° to 19° of Scorpio, which in most years means birthdays from November 2 to November 11. Its sub-ruler, Neptune, comes from Pisces, the next water sign after Scorpio, so this decan borrows a little of Pisces's character while staying Scorpio at heart. The other two decans of Scorpio belong to Pluto (decan 1) and the Moon (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Neptune adds imagination, compassion and porous boundaries. Its decans are usually pictured as dreamy, artistic and spiritually inclined, deeply empathetic and occasionally vague, needing quiet time to separate their own feelings from other people's. Neptunian decans are often linked with music, film, healing professions and spiritual practice, and their usual lesson is to keep one foot on the ground. Set against Scorpio's intensity, loyalty, perception and emotional depth, that Neptune note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Scorpio decan 2
paragraphs: The central growth edge for this decan is boundaries that still allow compassion. A simple daily practice of noticing which feelings are theirs and which have been absorbed from others can bring surprising relief. Creative work often helps convert vague emotional weather into something tangible. It is also worth asking, before saying yes, whether a sacrifice is chosen or merely expected. Regular time near water, in quiet rooms or out in nature is traditionally suggested for Neptune-heavy temperaments. None of this dims their sensitivity. It gives that sensitivity a container, so they can keep caring deeply without being swept away.

Within Scorpio, decan 1 leans towards depth, focus and transformation at their most concentrated and decan 3 leans towards protective loyalty and emotional memory wrapped around a steel core. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: What does Neptune add to the second decan of Scorpio?
faq.answer: Neptune, the modern ruler of Pisces, brings intuition, imagination and empathy to this middle stretch of Scorpio. Natives are often described as perceptive and artistic, with a strong sense of undercurrents, though they may need firmer boundaries to avoid absorbing other people's emotions.

faq.question: What are the dates of Scorpio decan 2?
faq.answer: In most years November 2 to November 11, the days when the Sun is between 10° and 19° of Scorpio. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Scorpio decan 2?
faq.answer: Neptune. In the triplicity system each water sign's decans take the rulers of the water signs in order, starting with Scorpio's own ruler, Pluto.
